data.one_liner: Provides command line automation scripts to help setup aspects of a Flutter project.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package that provides various automation scripts executed via the terminal to help with project setup. It can configure things like Google Maps on Android and generate keystores for Android signing.
use_when: You want to automate the setup of Google Maps on Android for your Flutter project.
You need a quick way to generate keystores and set up Android signing configurations.
avoid_when: You are looking for Firebase auth or firestore CRUD setups, which were dropped in version 2.0.0.
You prefer manual configuration of your project files and native code.
strengths: Automates repetitive setup tasks like Android signing configurations.
Easily run directly via flutter pub run in the terminal.
weaknesses: Some previous core features like Firebase auth and Firestore CRUD setup have been dropped.
Requires external tools like keytool to be in your system path for certain scripts.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_automation as a dependency in your pubspec.yaml file. For Android signing, keytool must be available in your system path.
